# Offline MST reference fixtures

Generated with the existing `@atproto/repo` **0.8.10** installation, the MIT-licensed
TypeScript repository implementation from https://github.com/bluesky-social/atproto.
No upstream implementation code or private account data is included here.
The inputs and generated fixture data are synthetic.

The SHA-256 of the concatenation of `dist/mst/mst.js` and `dist/mst/util.js` is:

```
a64844f90b0efa258baccddfc75c9e4faa7d4a5b8b29d8fea64ecc6fd9f53fb4
```

- `reference.json`: before/after roots and complete MST node bytes constructed by
  the reference implementation, plus valid repository paths and operation metadata.
- `atoll_proofs.json`: compact node slices generated by Atoll from those new trees.
  On 2026-09-27 the reference implementation checked each operation's new value
  and applied all inverse edits using only these slices, reproducing all eight
  expected previous roots.

Coverage includes empty trees, initial growth, mixed edits, root collapse/growth,
last-record deletion, empty commits, and a maximum 200-operation mixed batch.
These checks concern MST structure and inductive proof interoperability. They do
not test signed commit validation, WebSocket framing, OAuth, live relays or AppViews.
Version 0.8.10 is a pinned compatibility target, not a claim about the latest release.

## Reproduce

Use Node and an **already-installed** matching package; these scripts install no
packages and make no network requests. Set its directory explicitly:

```sh
ATOLL_REFERENCE_REPO=/absolute/path/to/node_modules/@atproto/repo
node scripts/mst_reference.mjs generate "$ATOLL_REFERENCE_REPO" test/fixtures/mst/reference.json
mix run --no-start scripts/export_mst_proofs.exs test/fixtures/mst/reference.json test/fixtures/mst/atoll_proofs.json
node scripts/mst_reference.mjs verify "$ATOLL_REFERENCE_REPO" test/fixtures/mst/atoll_proofs.json
mix test test/atoll/mst_reference_test.exs
```

The reference verifier checks both the package version and implementation checksum.
Normal Elixir tests need neither Node nor the reference package: they compare
Atoll's builder/editor roots with the upstream fixtures and compare generated
proofs with the exact slices independently verified above. If proof generation
changes, regenerate and re-run the external verifier before accepting new slices.
